aaa_enabled.summary: Configure centralized authentication (RADIUS or LDAP) in pfSense.
aaa_enabled.notes: Navigate to System > User Manager > Servers and configure a remote RADIUS or LDAP authentication server.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Restrict WebGUI and SSH access in pfSense.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Navigate to System > Advanced > Admin Access and set Protocol to HTTPS, disable password login, or modify SSH options.

vty_idle_timeout.summary: Set administrative session timeout in pfSense.
vty_idle_timeout.notes: Navigate to System > User Manager > Settings and set the Session Timeout field to your desired duration in minutes.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure administrative account passwords are encrypted.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: pfSense local administrative passwords are automatically bcrypt-hashed.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: Remove or change default SNMP communities in pfSense.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: Navigate to Services > SNMP and change the Read-Only Community string to a complex, non-default value.

http_server_disabled.summary: Disable HTTP administrative access in pfSense.
http_server_disabled.notes: Navigate to System > Advanced > Admin Access and set the Protocol field to HTTPS.

ssh_version_2.notes: The native pfSense sshd daemon automatically enforces SSH Protocol 2.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure remote Syslog server destination targets.
logging_enabled.notes: Navigate to Status > System Logs > Settings, check 'Send log messages to remote syslog server', and enter the remote syslog server IP:port.

management_acl.summary: Restrict Web Management Console and SSH access to trusted IP hosts.
management_acl.notes: Create WAN/LAN interface firewall rules under Firewall > Rules targeting TCP WebGUI and SSH ports.

login_banner.summary: Configure login disclaimer banner in pfSense.
login_banner.notes: Create custom login warning text by setting SSH shell login message templates, or use a system package.

password_min_length.notes: Local password policies are not natively enforced; offload administrative authentication to LDAP or RADIUS to enforce complexity requirements.

ntp_configured.summary: Configure NTP synchronization settings in pfSense.
ntp_configured.notes: Navigate to Services > NTP > Settings and define your upstream NTP server pools.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: The built-in pfSense SNMP daemon (bsnmpd) does not support read-write communities by default.
